$comment: Compiles apps/api/src/data-source.ts and its migrations to plain CommonJS `.js`, independently of apps/api/webpack.config.js's NxAppWebpackPlugin bundle (T-C10-69). ADR-013 puts `typeorm migration:run` on Render's pre-deploy command, which runs inside the deployed image, at its WORKDIR — not through the webpack `main.js` bundle, which is a single opaque chunk `migration:run -d <path>` cannot target. `tools/build-api-runtime.mjs` invokes this tsconfig with `tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.migrations.json`.
